threads.body: [General] Vert.x 4.4.4 supports `REPLICATION`, so it reaches this fallback and its configured endpoints are sorted. Vert.x tries replication seeds in native order to locate the master, making that order part of the failover configuration; sorting it records a different target than configured. Detect this later-added enum value without directly linking it from the 4.0.0 compile baseline, and use `RedisServerTarget.ofEndpoints(...)` (with 4.4.4-era coverage).

replies.body:
Addressed in 47b62fcaad54d37ed691470aa04918d601dc8428.

Analysis: Vert.x added `RedisClientType.REPLICATION` after the instrumentation's 4.0.0 compile baseline. Comparing the runtime enum name detects it without linking the missing field, and `RedisServerTarget.ofEndpoints(...)` keeps the configured seed order. Running the unit tests with Vert.x 4.4.4 covers the added enum value.

Upsides: Replication targets now match the application's failover configuration while cluster targets remain order-independent.

Downsides: The compatibility check relies on the upstream enum constant name, and the unit-test classpath now targets Vert.x 4.4.4 instead of 4.0.0.

threads.body: [Build] This adds a separate project solely for direct javaagent helper tests, but new helper-test coverage is conventionally registered as a `JvmTestSuite` named `unitTests` in the javaagent project (for example, `instrumentation/jedis/jedis-1.4/javaagent/build.gradle.kts:29-38` and `instrumentation/jms/jms-common-1.1/javaagent/build.gradle.kts:12-19`). Please move these tests under `javaagent/src/unitTests`, declare their dependencies in that suite, and remove the extra subproject/settings wiring.
